description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Hon. Harini Amarasuriya of Prime Minister of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka effect from 24th September 2024.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the appointment of Honourable Harini Amarasuriya as Prime Minister of Sri Lanka. It names a specific individual (Harini Amarasuriya) and provides her title (Prime Minister), but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities, ministerial duties, or subject matter areas she will oversee. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) which covers government personnel changes with basic titles only.
